description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Soft Liquor Licenses, Excise Notification No. 05/2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new regulatory rules and licensing requirements for the consumption of soft liquor in tourism establishments. It is issued under the authority of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52), creates specific compliance requirements, and outlines the legal framework for obtaining and maintaining these licenses. The content focuses on regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
